required_behaviors: memory snapshot input is validated and deterministically digested
memory.get resolves exact record ids or one unique declared key without network or workspace writes
exact mode matches only case-sensitive ids or declared keys
exact mode never silently falls back to lexical or semantic retrieval
lexical mode uses a deterministic full-text inverted index with whole normalized terms and phrase-first ranking
kind filters, query-term budgets and result limits are explicit and deterministic
search hits are candidate-only and bind to raw memory.get reloads through record_digest
aggregate snapshot byte limits fail closed before full index construction
seed order does not change snapshot digest or hit ordering
returned records cannot mutate the internal snapshot by reference
duplicate record ids fail before calls are served
closed gateway WARM history projects into canonical memory records without copying raw large outputs
open or incomplete gateway history remains excluded from retrieval snapshots
gateway artifact refs are revalidated at the retrieval projection boundary
gateway-projected memory records are retrievable by canonical artifact ref and lexical tool id
every retrieval path including explicit ids or artifact refs requires exact raw reload before claim or action
semantic retrieval is not invoked by this slice
non_claims: canonical direct binding to the context gateway sqlite store
durable generic memory database behind memory primitives
